about: Apps Groundwork installs or sets up itself, and the Omarchy paths that could replace each one. Read by scripts/omarchy-feed-watch.py. Order of checks is AGENTS.md 'Omarchy first'. Apps already installed through omarchy pkg add or an Omarchy installer are listed under not_watched.

apps.name: T3 Code
apps.groundwork_method: official T3 Code Nightly CLI (https://t3.codes/install.sh), reconciled by setup and update-all
apps.offer: Omarchy installs T3 Code as its AppImage and themes it. Quit T3 Code first; the installer drops the t3code-bin packages and links ~/.local/bin/t3 only when nothing else is there. Groundwork's setup still reconciles the Nightly CLI, so wait for the T3 decision before moving.

self_install.evidence: The 16 KiB-page checks, pin, and smoke run in docs/apps/t3-code.md apply to the official CLI only. Whether to move to the feed packages or Omarchy's AppImage belongs to the T3 decision lane.

apps.name: Bitwarden desktop
apps.groundwork_method: user Flatpak com.bitwarden.desktop (fallback when the feed lacks bitwarden)
apps.offer: Setup moves the Flatpak to Omarchy's bitwarden package only with your yes (migration id bitwarden-flatpak). It checks the package on this kernel first and keeps ~/.var/app/com.bitwarden.desktop. Sign in again in the new app.

self_install.evidence: The Flatpak is only the fallback for a feed without bitwarden. pacman -Si bitwarden showed omarchy/bitwarden 2026.10.1-1 for aarch64 on 2026-10-28 (decision 0014).

apps.name: FreeTube
apps.offer: Omarchy now ships FreeTube. Check the package on this kernel's pages before moving; your data in ~/.var/app/io.freetubeapp.FreeTube/config/FreeTube does not move by itself.

self_install.evidence: Arch Linux, Arch Linux ARM, pkgs.omarchy.org/edge/aarch64, and ALARM's prebuilt aur database had no freetube package on 2026-10-24 (docs/apps.md#freetube).

apps.name: Tailscale
apps.groundwork_method: omarchy pkg add tailscale, then systemctl enable --now tailscaled; sign-in left to you
apps.offer: Omarchy's installer also runs tailscale up, sets you as operator, receives Taildrop files in ~/Downloads, and adds the bar plugin and an admin web app. It asks for tailnet sign-in while it runs.

self_install.evidence: omarchy-install-service-tailscale runs sudo tailscale up --accept-routes during install. Tailnet sign-in stays interactive and local, so setup and update-all do not run it (issue #18 scope).

apps.name: git-filter-repo
apps.offer: omarchy pkg add installs the system git-filter-repo. It counts only when git filter-repo -h lists --sensitive-data-removal. Then remove the per-user copy with mise unuse -g pipx:git-filter-repo.

self_install.evidence: The groundwork-core history-purge runbook names the per-user mise line, and distro packages older than 2.47 lack --sensitive-data-removal (docs/git-filter-repo.md). A system package that passes that check already satisfies the opt-in.

apps.name: Syncthing
apps.groundwork_method: omarchy pkg add syncthing, then Groundwork's own user service setup (scripts/groundwork-syncthing.py)
apps.offer: Omarchy now has its own Syncthing setup. Compare it with the tailnet-only listeners in decision 0013 before moving.

self_install.evidence: No omarchy-install-* command for Syncthing on 2026-10-31. Groundwork's setup binds Syncthing to the tailnet only (decision 0013).

apps.name: Desktop sharing (WayVNC)
apps.groundwork_method: omarchy pkg add wayvnc, then Groundwork's user service bound to the Tailscale address
apps.offer: Omarchy now has its own VNC setup. Compare it with the tailnet-only binding in docs/apps/screen-sharing.md before moving.

self_install.evidence: No omarchy-install-* command for WayVNC on 2026-10-31. omarchy-install-service-sunshine is a different protocol for Moonlight (decision 0004).

not_watched.cursor: omarchy pkg add cursor-bin, which is Omarchy's Install > Editor > Cursor (decisions 0009, 0014).
not_watched.keyd: omarchy pkg add keyd; Groundwork only writes its config (decision 0003).
not_watched.blip: omarchy plugin add from git (decision 0011); bun through omarchy-install-dev-env.
not_watched.packages.txt: An optional list; each entry is added by hand with omarchy pkg add.
